summary: Tennessee's register lists a Rich Mountain lookout in Campbell County at 2,369 ft and marks it removed; no other source describes the site.

facts.status_note: Tennessee's register lists the tower as removed. No source describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Register: Rich Mountain in Campbell County at 2,369 ft, marked removed
Register notes many Tennessee towers are removed and most locations are now private property
evidence.quote: Many have been removed, and most locations are now private property

evidence.supports: A different Rich Mountain near Hot Springs, NC, is a standing lookout
evidence.quote: Right out of the popular trail town of Hot Springs, the AT takes you almost up to a standing lookout on Rich Mountain.

evidence.supports: That Hot Springs lookout is listed as standing

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms register says anything about this tower. Searches for Campbell County towers, Jacksboro and LaFollette found no lookout. The NPS National Register record 64501237 was fetched and its cached text has no match for Campbell, Rich Mountain, Blount, Carter or Roan. The story is short for that reason. Do not add a build date or fate without a new source.
